title: px, %, em, rem
learningObjectives: Explain px, %, em, rem and apply it in a practical page layout.

understand.concept: CSS length units include absolute CSS pixels and relative units such as percentages, em, and rem. A percentage resolves against a property-specific reference, em relates to the relevant computed font size, and rem relates to the root element's computed font size.
understand.whyItMatters: Choosing units affects scaling, inheritance, and responsive behaviour. Do not assume every percentage is relative to the viewport; the reference depends on the property and layout context.
understand.analogy: Units are measuring rules. The same number can mean different rendered sizes depending on the unit and its reference.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is only a learning aid; actual sizing and layout follow CSS formatting rules.

explain.narrative: The child is half the parent's content width. The em text follows the parent's font size; rem follows the root font size.
